decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial care line is strongly aligned with the firm's existing natural facial care knowledge and in-house development capabilities, so after surviving its first phase it is more likely to be incrementally improved than withdrawn.

The facial cleansing milk remains close to the firm's established formulations and production base, and despite its more modest website prominence the firm can readily learn from market feedback and adjust it.

The facial cleansing oil fits the firm's core skincare competences and can be supported with existing know-how, but as the newest and less visibly committed launch it still carries somewhat higher withdrawal risk while the firm gathers experience.
